description: Text expressions requiring a source/code mapping or carrying user data. Never translate raw user data. Review before wiring.

filter === 'all' ? 'No active tables yet' : `No ${filters.find(([key]) => key === filter)?.[1]} tables yet`
expanded ? 'Hide bids and player status' : 'View bids and player status'
peekAll ? 'Tap to hide cards' : 'Tap to see cards'
editable ? 'Creator settings · save before starting' : 'Only the creator can edit settings before the game starts.'
key === 'weak_hand_enabled' ? 'Redeal with no card above Jack' : 'Redeal with no spades'

isTurn

      : `${ownBid != null ? `Your bid: ${ownBid}. ` : ''}Waiting for ${bidder} to bid.`
ready.length === 2 ? 'Both routes qualify — your choice' : 'A qualifying declaration is ready'
!group.held.length ? route === 'dublee' ? 'Need a new matching pair.' : 'Need a new natural sequence or Tunnela.' : `Need: ${group.missing.map(marriageFace).join(' + ')}`
win ? '🏆 Round won!' : initialTunnela ? 'Initial Tunnelas shown' : '✦ Maal unlocked'

win ? current.wonByFold ? 'won because all other players folded.' : current.dublee ? 'completed the 8th Dublee.' : 'completed a winning hand.' : initialTunnela ? 'declared Tunnelas before play.' : current.dublee ? 'showed 7 Dublees.' : 'showed 3 sequences / Tunnelas.'

possibleCopies
                    ? `Need another ${marriageFace(card)}.` : `${marriageFace(card)} cannot form a new pair: the other two copies are already locked.`
normal.ready ? 'Suggested final discard' : 'Cards outside these groups'

editable ? 'House bonus is the default. Choose a preset or edit any value, then propose the change for player approval.' : 'The creator selects these rules before the round. They are locked during play.'
draft.initial_tunnela_declaration?'Before the first draw, every player must show dealt Tunnelas or declare none. Only those initial declarations earn the Tunnela bonus.':'Tunnela bonus applies to'
scope === 'off' ? 'None' : scope === 'shown' ? draft.initial_tunnela_declaration?'Initially declared Tunnelas':'Shown Tunnelas' : 'All final Tunnelas'
!valid ? 'Enter whole numbers from 0 to 1000.' : changed ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Rule changes apply only after every seated player accepts.'

snapshot.status === 'ended' ? 'The game was ended without a winner. No final points were calculated.'
      : snapshot.status === 'finished' ? 'This round has no scoring breakdown available.' : 'Points appear here when the round finishes, using the saved scoring rules.'
p.eligible ? '' : ' / not eligible for Maal points'
p.eligible ? 'No scoring cards.' : 'Maal points are not counted because Maal was not seen.'
item.kind === 'friend_request' ? 'sent you a connection request.' : item.kind === 'friend_accepted' ? 'accepted your connection request.' : 'declined your connection request.'
hand.length ? `No ${suitNames[selectedSuit]?.toLowerCase() || 'cards'} left. Choose another suit.` : 'No cards in your hand.'
active ? mine ? 'YOU' : '● TURN' : !connected ? 'Offline' : mine ? 'YOU' : dealer ? 'Dealer' : status
recipient === null ? 'Everyone in this room will see it.' : `Only ${target} will see this message.`
privatePoke ? '✦ JUST FOR YOU' : '✦ TABLE TALK'
owner ? 'This deletes the room for everyone. End active tables first.' : 'This removes your room membership. Private rooms require a new invitation to rejoin.'
sessionActive ? 'Loading tables…' : 'Sign in again to load tables.'
seatConflict?.departure_command === 'end' ? 'Previous table is reserved' : seatConflict?.departure_command === 'abandon' ? 'Abandon active game?' : 'Leave previous table?'
seatConflict?.departure_command === 'end' ? 'Check table status' : seatConflict?.departure_command === 'abandon' ? 'Abandon previous game' : 'Leave previous table'
connectionMessage || (!connected ? 'Reconnecting… Your seat is saved.' : 'Updating game…')
gameType === 'flush' ? '2–10 players · lock the seated roster when ready.' : 'Seats'
sessionActive ? 'Waiting for the table service. Your form will stay open while it retries.' : 'Sign in again before creating a table.'
visibility === 'private' ? 'Only invited people and existing members can enter. Links do not grant access.' : 'Everyone can discover and join this room.'

table.phase === 'COMPLETED' ? 'Match completed · seats for the next match' : table.phase === 'LOCKED' ? 'Roster locked · ready to start' : `${table.seated_players.length}/${table.max_players} seated · ${table.phase.toLowerCase()}`
me.is_seated ? ` · Your seat ${me.seat_id}` : me.is_queued ? ` · Waitlist position ${me.queue_position}` : ' · Observing'
table?.phase === 'LOCKED' ? 'Players locked' : finished ? 'Ready for another round?' : 'Waiting for players'

played ? 'Reset table preview' : selected ? `Place ${selected} on the table` : 'Select a card to place'

settings.locked ? 'Rules locked for this game' : 'Rules before starting'

settings.locked ? 'New rules can be chosen for the next game.' : dirty ? 'Propose these changes for approval before starting.' : 'Edits need every seated player’s approval. One rejection keeps the current rules.'
!ended && !connectionReady ? 'Reconnecting… Updating game' : busy && myTurn ? 'Sending your action…' : turnText
helpOpen ? 'Hide action help' : 'Why are some actions unavailable?'
snapshot.ready ? 'Everyone is here. The first dealer will be chosen at random.' : 'Waiting for everyone to take a seat.'
selectedCard ? 'Confirm your discard below' : 'Select a card to discard'

shared.abandonRequired ? 'Abandon match and leave room' : 'Leave game and room'

authMode === 'signup'
              ? 'Create an account so your identity and profile can follow you across sign-ins.'
